summary: Completed E2E testing of AWS S3 File Storage integration for OEMLinker. All main features working correctly. Fixed category detection bug in FileManager.jsx.

issues: React hydration warning: <tr> cannot be child of <span> in table tbody - minor console warning, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Category detection in FileManager.jsx - was checking for '/machines/' but S3 paths don't have leading slash. Updated to check for both 'machines/' and '/machines/'
